Category.description_en:
The [product edition]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/183258.html）. Valid values:

Normal: Cluster Edition

Basic: Single Node

Archive: X-Engine

NormalMultimaster: Multi-master Cluster Edition

SENormal: Standard Edition

PolarDB for PostgreSQL clusters of PostgreSQL 11 do not support the single node edition.

PolarDB for MySQL clusters of 8.0 and 5.7, and PolarDB for PostgreSQL clusters of PostgreSQL 14 support the Standard Edition.

PolarDB for MySQL clusters of 8.0 support X-Engine and the Multi-master Cluster Edition
Category.description_zh:
[产品系列]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/183258.html），取值范围如下：
Normal：集群版
Basic：单节点
Archive：高压缩引擎（X-Engine）
NormalMultimaster：多主架构集群版
SENormal：标准版

PolarDB PostgreSQL版PostgreSQL 11版本不支持单节点。
PolarDB MySQL版8.0版本、5.7版本，PolarDB PostgreSQL版PostgreSQL 14版本支持标准版。
PolarDB MySQL版8.0版本，支持高压缩引擎（X-Engine）和多主架构集群版

FailoverPriority.description_en:
The failover priority. Each node has a failover priority. A higher priority value indicates a higher probability that the node is elected as the primary node during a failover.
Valid values: 1 to 15
FailoverPriority.description_zh:
Failover优先级。每个节点都有一个Failover优先级，决定了当故障切换时，该节点被选举为主节点的概率高低。数值越大，优先级越高。
取值范围为1~15

ON: Enabled

OFF: Disabled
HotReplicaMode.description_zh:
是否开启热备。取值范围如下：

ON：开启

ImciSwitch.description_zh:

MaxConnections.description_en: The maximum number of concurrent connections to the cluster

MaxIOPS.description_en: The maximum number of input/output operations per second (IOPS)

MemorySize.description_en: The memory size of the node. Unit: MB

SubCluster.description_en:
Indicates whether the node is in the primary or secondary zone. This parameter is mainly used for resource peering.
Valid values:

Primary: The primary zone

Standby: The secondary zone
SubCluster.description_zh:
查看节点是在主可用区还是备可用区，主要是资源对等形态在用。
取值范围如下：
Primary：主可用区
Standby：备可用区

DBVersionStatus.description_en:
The status of the current minor version of the database. Valid values:

Stable: The current version is stable.

Old: The current version is old. We recommend that you upgrade the cluster to the latest version.

HighRisk: The current version has critical bugs. Upgrade the cluster to the latest version immediately.

Beta: The current version is a beta version.

For more information about how to upgrade the minor engine version, see [Upgrade versions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158572.html）.

This parameter is returned only when the DBType parameter is set to MySQL
DBVersionStatus.description_zh:
当前数据库小版本状态，取值范围如下：
Stable：当前版本状态稳定。
Old：当前版本过旧，建议升级到最新版本。
HighRisk：当前版本有严重缺陷，请立即升级到最新的版本。
Beta：当前版本为 Beta 版。

关于如何升级数据库小版本，请参见[版本升级]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158572.html）。
仅当数据库引擎类型（DBType）为MySQL时，返回当前参数

DataLevel1BackupChainSize.description_en: The total size of level-1 backups (snapshots). Unit: bytes
DataLevel1BackupChainSize.description_zh: 一级备份（快照）总大小，单位为Byte

DataSyncMode.description_en:
The data replication relationship mode. Valid values:

AsyncSync: Asynchronous

SemiSync: Semi-synchronous
DataSyncMode.description_zh:
数据复制关系模式。取值范围如下：
AsyncSync：异步
SemiSync：半同步

DeletionLock.description_en:
The lock state of the cluster for deletion. Valid values:

0: The cluster is not locked and can be deleted.

1: The cluster is locked and cannot be deleted
DeletionLock.description_zh:
集群删除的锁定状态，取值范围如下：
0：未锁定，可删除集群。
1：锁定，不可删除集群

ExpireTime.description_en:
The expiration time of the cluster.

This parameter is returned only for Prepaid (subscription) clusters. An empty value is returned for Postpaid (pay-as-you-go) clusters
ExpireTime.description_zh:
集群到期时间。

仅付费方式为Prepaid（包年包月）的集群会返回具体参数值，Postpaid（按量付费）集群则返回空值。

Expired.description_en:
Indicates whether the cluster has expired.

This parameter is returned only for subscription clusters
Expired.description_zh:
集群是否到期。
仅付费方式为Prepaid（包年包月）的集群支持返回该参数

HasCompleteStandbyRes.description_en:

true: Yes

false: No

是否在跨可用区切换后补齐新主库资源。取值范围如下：
true：是
false：否

HotStandbyCluster.description_en:
Indicates whether the hot standby storage cluster (and standby compute nodes) feature is enabled. Valid values:

StandbyClusterON: The hot standby storage cluster feature or both the hot standby storage cluster and standby compute node features are enabled.

StandbyClusterOFF: The hot standby storage cluster feature or both the hot standby storage cluster and standby compute node features are disabled
HotStandbyCluster.description_zh:
是否开启存储热备集群(和Standby计算节点)。取值范围如下：
StandbyClusterON：开启存储热备/开启存储热备和Standby计算节点。 
StandbyClusterOFF：关闭存储热备/关闭存储热备和Standby计算节点

ImciAutoIndex.description_en:

`OFF`: Disabled

自动列存索引提速功能。取值范围如下：
`ON`：开启。
`OFF`：关闭

ImperceptibleSwitch.description_en:
Failover with hot replica. Valid values:

`true`: Enabled.

`false`: Disabled
ImperceptibleSwitch.description_zh:
无感切换。取值范围如下：
`true`：开启。
`false`：关闭

false: No

true: Yes

Unlock: The cluster is not locked.

锁定模式。取值范围如下： 

Unlock：未锁定。
ManualLock：手动触发锁定。 
LockByExpiration：集群过期自动锁定

MaintainTime.description_en: The maintenance window of the cluster. The time is in the `HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ` format and is displayed in UTC. For example, `16:00Z-17:00Z` indicates that routine maintenance can be performed from 00:00 to 01:00 (UTC+8)
MaintainTime.description_zh: 集群的可维护时间段，格式为`HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ`（UTC时间）。例如`16:00Z-17:00Z`表示，0点到1点（UTC+08:00）可以进行例行维护

Orca.description_en:
The Orca feature. Valid values:

on: Enabled

off: Disabled
Orca.description_zh:
Orca功能，取值如下：

on：开启

off：关闭

PayType.description_en:

Postpaid: Pay-as-you-go.

Prepaid: Subscription
PayType.description_zh:
付费类型。取值范围如下：

Postpaid：按量付费。
Prepaid：预付费（包年包月）

ProvisionedIops.description_en:
<props="china">

The read and write IOPS that are preconfigured for the ESSD AutoPL disk. Valid values: 0 to min{50,000, 1,000 × Capacity - Baseline IOPS}.

</props>

<props="china">

Baseline IOPS = min{1,800 + 50 × Capacity, 50,000}.

</props>

<props="china">

This parameter is supported only when StorageType is set to ESSDAUTOPL.

</props>
ProvisionedIops.description_zh:
ESSD AutoPL云盘预配置的读写IOPS。可能值：0~min{50,000, 1000*容量-基准性能}。

基准性能=min{1,800+50*容量, 50000}。

当StorageType为ESSDAUTOPL时才支持该参数。

ProxyCpuCores.description_en: The number of CPU cores for the database proxy

AgileServerless: Agile. This indicates a Serverless cluster.

SteadyServerless: Steady. This indicates a cluster with defined specifications (a subscription or pay-as-you-go cluster)

数据库代理Serverless类型。取值范围如下：
AgileServerless：敏态，即Serverless集群。
SteadyServerless：稳态，即固定规格集群（计费类型为包年包月或按量付费的集群）

ProxyStandardCpuCores.description_en: The number of CPU cores for the database proxy with standard specifications
ProxyStandardCpuCores.description_zh: 数据库代理标准配置CPU核数

DBNodeCreating: A node is being added.

The type of the database proxy. Valid values:

Exclusive: Dedicated Enterprise Edition

General: Standard Enterprise Edition
ProxyType.description_zh:
数据库代理类型，取值范围如下：

Exclusive：企业独享版
General ：企业通用版

RestoreDataPoint.description_en:
If RestoreType is set to RestoreByTime or RestoreByTimeOss, this parameter indicates the point in time for the restoration.

If RestoreType is set to RestoreByBackupSet or RestoreByBackupSetOss, this parameter indicates the ID of the backup set that is used for the restoration.

This parameter is supported only for clusters that are restored from a backup set or a point in time after June 1, 2024
RestoreDataPoint.description_zh:
若 RestoreType 为 RestoreByTime 或 RestoreByTimeOss，该值表示恢复的时间点。
若 RestoreType 为 RestoreByBackupSet 或 RestoreByBackupSetOss，该值表示恢复所基于的备份集ID。

<note>仅2024年6月1日以后从备份集或时间点恢复的集群支持该参数</note>

RestoreType.description_en:
The method used to restore the cluster. Valid values:

RestoreByTime: The cluster is restored from a point in time based on a level-1 backup.

RestoreByBackupSet: The cluster is restored from a backup set based on a level-1 backup.

RestoreByTimeOss: The cluster is restored from a point in time based on a level-2 backup.

RestoreByBackupSetOss: The cluster is restored from a backup set based on a level-2 backup.

CloneFromSourceCluster: The cluster is cloned from a source cluster.

This parameter is supported only for clusters that are restored from a backup set or a point in time after June 1, 2024
RestoreType.description_zh:
集群恢复方式，其值可能为：

RestoreByTime：基于一级备份从时间点恢复。
RestoreByBackupSet：基于一级备份从备份集恢复。
RestoreByTimeOss：基于二级备份从时间点恢复。
RestoreByBackupSetOss：基于二级备份从备份集恢复。
CloneFromSourceCluster：从源集群克隆。

<note>仅2024年6月1日以后从备份集或时间点恢复的集群支持该参数</note>

SQLSize.description_en: The storage usage for SQL. Unit: bytes. A value of -1 indicates that no data is available
SQLSize.description_zh: SQL的存储量，单位为Byte。若数值为-1，则表示没有数据

ServerlessType.description_en:
The Serverless type. Valid values:

AgileServerless: Agile

SteadyServerless: Steady
ServerlessType.description_zh:
Serverless类型。取值范围如下：

AgileServerless：敏态
SteadyServerless：稳态

SourceDBCluster.description_en:
The source cluster ID.

This parameter is supported only for clusters that are restored from a backup set or a point in time after June 1, 2024
SourceDBCluster.description_zh:
源集群ID。
<note>仅2024年6月1日以后从备份集或时间点恢复的集群支持该参数</note>

SourceRegionId.description_en:

源集群所处地域ID。
<note>仅源集群ID存在的情况下才可能返回。</note>

OFF: The cross-zone disaster recovery mode is disabled.

0: Customer drill mode
StandbyHAMode.description_zh:
跨可用容灾模式。取值范围如下：
ON：开启跨可用容灾模式。
OFF：关闭跨可用容灾模式。
0：客户演练模式

StorageMax.description_en: The maximum storage capacity of the current cluster specifications. Unit: bytes
StorageMax.description_zh: 当前集群规格的最大存储容量，单位为Byte

The billing method for storage. Valid values:

Postpaid: Pay-as-you-go.

StoragePayType.description_zh:

Postpaid：按容量计费（按量付费）。

StorageType.description_en:
The storage class of the Enterprise Edition. Valid values:

PSL4

ESSDPL0

ESSDPL1

ESSDPL2

ESSDPL3

ESSDAUTOPL

OFF: Strong consistency is not enabled for the multi-zone cluster
StrictConsistency.description_zh:

ON：表示开启了多可用区数据强一致，适用于标准版3AZ场景。

OFF：表示未开启多可用区数据强一致

SupportInstantSwitchWithImci.description_en: Indicates whether the failover with hot replica feature that is compatible with the IMCI feature is supported
SupportInstantSwitchWithImci.description_zh: 是否支持兼容列存IMCI的无感秒切功能
